title: Hermeus news feature
description: A white band leading with one story: the index label, a wide 16:9 image across the column (edge to edge on phones), a bold two-line headline, a one-paragraph summary and a crop-mark button. Each part fades up and rises into place as it scrolls in.
notes: CSS scroll-driven reveals; without support, and under reduced motion, everything shows in place
name: hermeus-news-feature
